title: Cognitive Disorders and Brain Pulse
summary: Following an initial consultation with a memory, resources and research centre (MRRC) doctor, a day hospital may be prescribed to carry out an assessment of cognitive disorders. Patients are then usually followed up in consultation at least once a year, in the framework of a new day hospital and/or consultations with a MRRC doctor.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient benefiting from a day hospital at the MRRC of the CHU of Tours for assessment of cognitive functions

Exclusion Criteria:

* Refusal of TPI ultrasound examination
* Patients who opposed to data processing
* Patients under judicial protection
